sentences.text: Gopala Ratnam Subramaniam -LRB- born 2 June 1955 -RRB- , commonly known by his screen name Mani Ratnam , is an Indian film director , screenwriter , and producer who predominantly works in Tamil cinema .	Tamil cinema	Tamil cinema

Cited by the media as one of India 's influential filmmakers , Mani Ratnam is widely credited with revolutionising the Tamil film industry and altering the profile of Indian cinema .	Indian cinema	Indian cinema
Although working in the mainstream medium , his films are noted for their realism , technical finesse , and craft .	realism	Realism (art movement)
The Government of India honoured him with the Padma Shri , acknowledging his contributions to film in 2002 .	Government of India	Government of India	Padma Shri	Padma Shri
Despite being born into a film family , Mani Ratnam did not develop any interest towards films when he was young .
Upon completion of his post graduation in management , he started his career as a consultant .
He entered the film industry through the 1983 Kannada film Pallavi Anu Pallavi .	Kannada film	Kannada cinema	Pallavi Anu Pallavi	Pallavi Anu Pallavi
The failure of his subsequent films would mean that he was left with fewer offers .
However , his fifth directorial outing , Mouna Ragam -LRB- 1986 -RRB- , established him as a leading filmmaker in Tamil cinema .	Tamil cinema	Tamil cinema	Mouna Ragam	Mouna Ragam
He followed that with the Godfatheresque Nayagan -LRB- 1987 -RRB- , which is regarded as a cult film over the years .	Godfatheresque	The Godfather	Nayagan	Nayakan (1987 film)	cult film	cult film
Mani Ratnam is well known for his `` Political trilogy '' consisting of Roja -LRB- 1992 -RRB- , Bombay -LRB- 1995 -RRB- , and Dil Se .	Roja	Roja	Bombay	Bombay (film)
